films.title: The Last One and then We Go
films.overview: A group of mariachis receives a letter to be part of the National Mariachi Contest in Mexico City. In order to be able to win they will need to travel together and solve their differences since their prime was 30 years ago.

films.title: Can't Quit Mom
films.overview: At the Holly Day of The Deaths, a mother returns and finds that her three sons are desconsidered, ugly and lazy.

films.title: Unhappily Ever After
films.overview: María José and Alfredo are about to celebrate their 20th anniversary and their children give them a trip to the hotel where they celebrated their honeymoon, but a spell will make them repeat the same day.

films.title: Wedding Registry
films.overview: Nicolás and Antonia plan a fake wedding to share the gifts and fund their dreams.

films.title: Veinteañera, divorciada y fantástica
films.overview: Regina, our young protagonist, always dreamed of getting married. And she did it - but the dream lasted much less than she thought and now she has to face life in a very funny way as a divorcee.
